requested_outcome: Implement every item in the saved Kira and Liran correction lists, reconcile legacy mismatches against live supplier/API truth, and produce a regression-tested release candidate with every API limitation mapped to the affected item IDs.
natural_destination: The VII public product families and their owning API, normalization, search, gallery, booking, localization, SEO and administration layers.
authorization_boundary: Local code, read-only live API diagnostics, local builds and tests are authorized. Production deployment, DNS or primary-domain cutover, indexation-policy publication, outbound email, supplier writes and production database mutations require separate explicit authorization.

lesson_bundle.reason: The task explicitly compares the replacement product with legacy behavior and content.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every Kira and Liran item must be classified as preserved, intentionally replaced, repaired, upstream-blocked or not applicable, with source and evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The lists contain filters, galleries, loaders, share, review, booking and navigation interactions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Changed interactions require desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low-height coverage for success, loading, empty, failure, retry, reset, close, back and persistence where applicable.

lesson_bundle.reason: Availability, pricing, minimum nights, units, packages, amenities and media follow VII-specific world and supplier rules.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Supplier/API truth and the VII master plan govern the fix; legacy output is a discrepancy signal rather than automatic authority.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the examples are repaired while equivalent worlds, routes or states remain broken.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory shared components, routes, locales, viewports, supplier modes and data states before editing, then test the whole affected family.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The final family matrix contains every KIRA-01..12 and LIRAN-01..29 item with route and state evidence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Legacy differences are copied blindly even when the old site is stale or the supplier API says something else.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Probe the live read-only API first, inspect normalization and filtering second, and use legacy only to locate discrepancies.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Each data discrepancy records the live source response shape, local interpretation, cause class and mapped correction IDs.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The UI looks fixed but availability, price, CTA or media identity still contradict each other.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one truth contract from provider response through canonical normalization, filters and rendered action, with identity-preserving media ownership.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Representative vacation, event, spa and hourly flows agree on availability, price, minimum stay, unit identity, CTA and gallery.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Performance work hides waits or errors instead of removing duplicate requests, caps, cache misses or rendering races.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reproduce and diagnose network, cache, query and render timing with competing hypotheses before changing loaders or fallbacks.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Before-and-after timing evidence and atomic-state tests show no contradictory skeleton, empty, retry or result flashes.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A production claim is made even though this message did not authorize publication or owner-level controls remain unavailable.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep production unchanged and label the output as a tested release candidate until explicit publication authorization.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No deployment, DNS, indexation or external write occurs; remaining authorization-only actions are listed precisely.

affected_family: vacation, event, spa and hourly search/result routes
availability, minimum-stay, capacity, price and CTA normalization
place and unit detail pages, galleries, video, amenities and sharing
loading, caching, back navigation and responsive transitions
Hebrew, English, Russian and French routes and directionality
robots, sitemap, canonical, redirects, deployment identity and release evidence
administration, review moderation and advertising request workflows

sources.label: VII approved product and architecture decisions

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the live-API discrepancy ledger and first representative end-to-end fix for each world are complete, before expanding shared changes to every family member.
checks: Every data issue is classified as upstream API, adapter/normalization, filter/ranking, cache, rendering or legacy-only discrepancy.
One representative vacation, event, spa and hourly flow passes source-to-UI truth checks.
No shared fix changes unrelated typography, layout, content, routing or conversion behavior.

attack_questions: Can a one-night search still hide a property whose minimum stay is two or more nights instead of showing the truthful minimum?
Can a place or unit still expose a price, availability message, CTA or gallery that belongs to a different source identity?
Can back, refresh, tab switching, mobile transition or a slow/error response produce a contradictory blank, retry or stale-results state?
Can a non-Hebrew route leak Hebrew, overflow horizontally or point to the wrong canonical or sitemap state?
Can a full results or gallery page still inherit a slider pagination cap?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Local production-mode candidate captures, request traces and flow results on the exact representative routes, followed by production evidence only after separate publication authorization.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated and visual matrices across route families, worlds, locales, viewports, data modes and error states.

effectiveness.baseline: Public v917 at source c8cbda44 has two saved correction lists containing 12 Kira and 29 Liran families, with repeated reports of regressions and legacy/API uncertainty.
effectiveness.target: All 41 families have evidence or a precise upstream/authorization blocker, with zero unclassified legacy/API mismatches and no high or critical regression in the release candidate.
